## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(simling)
```

## The data

`turn_taking` comes from a simulated study of conversation in 10 languages. For 3000 yes/no questions, `offset` is the gap in ms between the end of the question and the start of the answer; negative values mean the answer started before the question ended. `response` says whether the answer confirms or disconfirms the question, and `gaze` whether the person asking was looking at the person answering.

```{r}
glimpse(turn_taking)
```

Today's question: what makes an answer come sooner or later?
